content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy, Stripe, and PayPal each provide operational capabilities for selling digital products, but their offerings come with substantial limitations for creators in restricted countries. Lemon Squeezy focuses on a simple interface for selling digital goods but is unavailable in many regions. Stripe, while powerful in the few countries it operates, serves only 46 out of 195 globally, leaving many creators without a payment solution. PayPal may allow for transactions, but account suspensions can freeze funds for up to 180 days with no recourse, undermining the reliability creators need. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack offers comprehensive deployment of digital stores with automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring creators can sell without these limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The approach to handling restricted countries varies drastically among these platforms. Stripe and PayPal essentially exclude creators based on their geographic location, leaving many without any viable option. Lemon Squeezy doesn’t even enter the conversation for those in restricted markets. This creates a vacuum where creators are left to either forgo online sales or seek unreliable workarounds. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, addresses this issue by allowing creators from any country to deploy their digital stores without geographic restrictions. With solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, anyone can set up a fully operational store irrespective of their location, thanks to decentralized payment processing methods.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for any digital creator. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often involve hidden costs and delays. Stripe may take days to process payments, while PayPal can suspend accounts, locking funds without warning. Lemon Squeezy has similar drawbacks, particularly for those in restricted regions. On the other hand, the Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments with a mere 0.5% fee and ensures immediate payment verification through on-chain processes. This architecture not only minimizes costs but also guarantees that creators receive their funds without the uncertainty and delay associated with traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full control over their revenue.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital content and customer data is a pressing concern for creators. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal, creators often find themselves at the mercy of these services, risking their access to both their funds and customer relationships. Lemon Squeezy presents a similar challenge by not allowing true ownership of the sales process. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack give creators complete ownership of their digital storefronts, data, and transactions. Automation features streamline product deliveries and payment confirmations, offering a seamless experience that traditional platforms fail to provide.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends heavily on your specific needs as a creator. If you are in a restricted country and seeking immediate control over your sales process, the Edge Commerce Stack is the clear choice. It offers a complete deployment in 48 hours with no reliance on conventional payment platforms. Meanwhile, platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Stripe may seem appealing but ultimately leave you vulnerable to account suspensions and payment delays. Opting for sovereign infrastructure not only secures your revenue but also fortifies your independence as a creator.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Account suspensions on platforms like PayPal can jeopardize your earnings for months.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
